title: Flow Field
description: Particle trails following a noise-based vector field.

title: Strange Attractor
description: A mesmerizing, evolving cosmic web based on the Peter de Jong attractor.

title: Interference
description: Op-art gratings read through a warped plane; the large shapes are the beat frequency between two ring sets.

title: Economic Tides
description: An abstract visualization driven by FRED data (interest rates, unemployment, and inflation).

title: Correlation Constellation
description: Eighteen US ETFs placed only by how their weekly returns move together, replayed from 2007; the cloud collapses in every crisis and separates again in calm.

title: Kaleidoscope Fold
description: A raymarched volume where six passes of fold-and-rotate smear space into a faceted tunnel; the seams glow where the ray grazes the distance field while a slow axis-angle rotation keeps the geometry from ever repeating.

title: Spiral Mandala
description: A raymarched logarithmic spiral: each ray step warps space into log-polar coordinates so concentric rings collapse onto themselves as the ray marches in, with hue tied to ring count and a sweeping time term that rotates the whole mandala through the spectrum without repeating.

title: Filtered Momentum
description: A revenue stream of a diversified financial-services firm, five years of weekly history plus a sixth year being lived through. The trend is pulled out by repeated centered moving averages (the Kolmogorov-Zurbenko low-pass), extrapolated at the record edge, re-anchored to the recent seasonally-adjusted level, and stitched back together with the recovered seasonal pattern to project the year-to-date total forward; a run-rate built from the historical share of annual revenue realized by each week and a naive last-year scaling race it to the realized annual total, with a live error table scoring each method. Filter settings, edge strategies, and synthetic segments - steady, accelerating, decelerating, or shocked years - rotate.
